Company description: V (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Visa Inc., traded under the ticker V, is a global leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Founded in 1958 as BankAmericard by Bank of America, the program expanded internationally in the 1970s, leading to the formation of Visa International Service Association in 1976. The company completed a historic initial public offering in 2008, which was the largest IPO in US history at the time. Operating primarily through its proprietary global processing network, VisaNet, the company does not issue cards, extend credit, or set rates and fees for consumers. Instead, it provides the secure technological infrastructure, authorization, clearing, and settlement services that enable electronic commerce. Visa generates revenue predominantly through service, data processing, and international transaction fees derived from the sheer volume of financial transactions processed through its network.
